description.value: Pho Dundas is a Vietnamese noodle restaurant in East Vancouver specializing in traditional pho broth soups alongside specialty sate varieties and fresh appetizers like salad rolls and bao sliders. The kitchen accommodates a range of diets with dedicated vegan and gluten-free menu sections. Online ordering with pickup and Uber Delivery options makes it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully operational with an active Square-powered online ordering system, confirming the business is open. The website confirms the address (2077 Dundas Street, Vancouver, BC V5L1J5) and provides a phone number (604) 420-1200 not present in OSM. The menu explicitly lists Vegan Noodle Soups, Vegan Appys, Vegan Main, and Gluten free Items categories, and the order page confirms pickup/takeout availability. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website and postal code V5L1J5 indicate the address is in Vancouver proper (East Vancouver), not North Vancouver.
Phone number (604) 420-1200 is present on the website but absent from the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active Vietnamese restaurant with confirmed online ordering and a full menu; real, open, and publicly accessible.
